visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four women stand in a tight circle in a luxuriously decorated room with warm lighting. A man in a plaid shirt and cap lies on the floor inside the circle with his hands behind his head. The women wear varied outfits: a purple cropped hoodie, a white top with a black skirt, a pink top with grey shorts, and a black top with a khaki skirt. A pink text overlay at the bottom shows a countdown starting at '6'. (2) The women begin an energetic dance, moving in a clockwise circle around the man. They are smiling and laughing, gesturing with their hands. The background features high-end furniture, a well-stocked bar shelf, and a patterned rug. The countdown numbers change from 5 down to 1 in pink text. (3) As the countdown ends, one woman in the khaki skirt suddenly clutches her chest area and leans forward. The group breaks into laughter. New subtitles appear in pink. The man on the floor looks up and smiles.
